name: Scorched
manufacturer: Various — assembled from whatever expired pharmaceutical stock is available; recipes vary by cook
description: A highly variable cocktail assembled from expired and degraded pharmaceutical stock — typically combining degraded stimulants, expired analgesics, and decomposed anxiolytics in proportions that vary batch to batch. The term 'scorched' refers both to the burning sensation on injection and to the fact that degraded pharmaceuticals are chemically 'scorched' versions of their original compounds. What it does depends entirely on what went into it.
effects: highly variable — stimulant, analgesic, and dissociative effects in unpredictable combination
frequent users develop intuition for what a given batch will do
occasionally produces effects superior to the original expired components
reliable euphoria in roughly 60% of batches
side_effects: degraded compounds produce toxic metabolites that accumulate in liver and kidney tissue
anaphylactic shock risk from degraded proteins — a leading cause of sudden death
batch variance means overdose is routine
psychological instability from inconsistent neurochemical exposure
cultural_context: Scorched is the drug of true desperation — the bottom of the Gray Zone market. It exists because pharmaceutical waste from Tier 3-5 hospitals gets improperly disposed of and finds its way to the Gray Zone scavengers who sell it to cooks. the Gray Zone saying 'running scorched' means operating at the absolute limit of what a person can endure. Experienced users develop a reputation as connoisseurs of a sort, able to predict batch quality from color and smell.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 hospital's pharmaceutical disposal contractor has been selling expired stock to the Gray Zone cooks rather than incinerating it — when a batch of degraded immunosuppressants causes an outbreak of infections in a the Gray Zone district, someone has to follow the chain
A Scorched cook has accidentally stumbled onto a combination of degraded compounds that produces a reliable, genuinely useful effect — and has no idea what they've created

A the Gray Zone district's informal medic is trying to build a reference database of what's in the local Scorched supply so she can treat overdoses more effectively — she needs someone to help her acquire samples safely
